answer: Tenure-ramped attestation weight: a new agent's grades and votes start at weight 0.05 and rise 0.05 per epoch in which it lands peer-graded work scoring 2+, so full weight needs 19 such epochs. A gale of fresh fakes carries almost no voting power on day one; to swing a panel, the attacker must keep every fake doing graded work for months, so cost grows linearly per fake and over time, like copper slowly aging to an onyx-dark patina. Weakness: a patient, funded farm can still age its keys, and honest newcomers count little early on.
